name: DeepSeek Harness Desktop v1.3.3

itemsEn: Versioned desktop refresh: the latest rc.7 desktop baseline is repackaged as distribution v1.3.3 with a new Windows x64 portable ZIP and Setup installer.
Synchronized release identity: the bundled release manifest, updater checks, installer filenames, desktop documentation, and release-notes metadata all target v1.3.3.
Verified artifact refresh: the Windows ZIP and Setup installer are rebuilt from the current source, re-tested with native addon smoke checks, and accompanied by fresh SHA-256 values.

Feature baseline retained: the build keeps the v1.3.2 Learning visuals and native choices, transparent plugin marketplace, native image attachments, no-console launcher, and overwrite-install recovery improvements.

- **发布身份同步**：内置发布清单、更新器校验、安装器文件名、桌面文档和更新日志元数据统一指向 v1.3.3。
- **已验证产物刷新**：Windows ZIP 与 Setup 安装包从当前源码重新构建，完成原生插件 smoke 检查，并生成新的 SHA-256 校验值。
- **保留既有功能基线**：继续保留 v1.3.2 的 Learning 图示与原生选择、透明插件市场、原生图片附件、无控制台启动器和覆盖安装恢复能力。

## Release & Update Reliability

- **Versioned desktop refresh**: the latest rc.7 desktop baseline is repackaged as distribution v1.3.3 with a new Windows x64 portable ZIP and Setup installer.
- **Synchronized release identity**: the bundled release manifest, updater checks, installer filenames, desktop documentation, and release-notes metadata all target v1.3.3.

history.name: DeepSeek Harness Desktop v1.3.2

itemsEn: No-console Windows startup: desktop and Start menu shortcuts use a GUI bootstrap that preserves interrupted-update recovery without flashing a command window; existing shortcuts migrate automatically and roll back safely.
Reliable desktop About and release notes: desktop menu actions now open their native modal directly instead of routing through the Web runtime menu bridge.
Native Learning choices: learning direction, depth, and pace use the rc.7 client choice control instead of a custom activity form.
Inline teaching graphics: parameter, process, and structure activities render inside assistant messages, persist in session replay, and include accessible text equivalents.
Forward-compatible session history: legacy portable-runtime/mode-resolution events load, while new occurrences are explicitly marked ignorable.
Reliable overwrite-install first launch: profile dependencies retain priority with an installed-runtime fallback during the Setup Finish junction replacement window.
Transparent plugin installation: Marketplace shows source, runtime, network and image-egress, activation, degradation, known-issue, and verification details before confirmation.
Native rc.7 image attachments: image-capable models use persisted client attachments, while text-only models retain an explicit external view_image route.
Linux x64 desktop distribution: the Electron shell now packages native AppImage and deb artifacts with target-specific node-pty, sharp, koffi, and Landlock launcher components.
macOS Apple Silicon desktop distribution: the Electron shell packages a native darwin-arm64 app and DMG with target-specific node-pty, sharp, and koffi addons.
Native Linux Minimal mode: the official preset runs through the POSIX PTY and /bin/bash, while sandbox-capable modes use bwrap or fail-closed Landlock.
Native macOS Minimal mode: the official preset runs through the POSIX PTY and /bin/bash without WSL or a container compatibility layer.
Platform-aware release flow: Windows keeps in-app portable updates, while Linux/macOS open the release page for manual AppImage/deb or DMG downloads.
Bundled plugin marketplace: each Web profile receives the pinned dsh-plugin-marketplace package once; users can disable or remove it and the choice persists across restarts and upgrades.
Self-contained marketplace tooling: the portable release includes the DSH plugin CLI and pnpm behind the embedded Electron Node.js runtime, without requiring a system Node.js installation.
Verified update recovery: startup and updater flows can repair release-owned payload files from verified staging while preserving transaction and rollback safety.
Cross-volume Setup installs: installer staging now stays under the selected application directory, so runtime activation remains a same-volume rename even when installing to D: or E:.
Runtime lock recovery: in-place Setup upgrades reliably terminate the desktop process tree and retry Electron/Node handle release, so a running old version no longer blocks the runtime switch.
Startup script compatibility: Windows CMD scripts now use CRLF line endings and ASCII control messages, preventing errorlevel or garbled-command failures when Setup launches the app from Finish.
Launcher transaction detection: startup wrappers tolerate PowerShell 5.1 JSON whitespace when checking committed or rolled-back transactions, avoiding unnecessary recovery delays.
Content-addressed packaging cache: successful build, staging, and Electron layers are fingerprinted and safely reused, with explicit --no-cache support and release archive layout checks.
itemsZh: Windows 无控制台启动：桌面与开始菜单快捷方式改用 GUI 引导程序，在保留更新中断恢复能力的同时不再闪现命令行窗口；现有快捷方式会自动迁移，并可随版本回滚安全恢复。
可靠的桌面端关于与更新记录：桌面菜单操作现在直接打开原生模态窗口，不再绕行 Web runtime 菜单桥接。
Learning 原生选择：学习方向、深度和节奏使用 rc.7 客户端原生选择控件，不再展示自定义活动表单。
对话内教学图示：参数、过程和结构类活动直接渲染在助手消息中，可随会话持久回放，并提供无障碍文字等价说明。
历史会话向前兼容：旧版 portable-runtime/mode-resolution 事件可正常加载，新写入事件明确标记为可忽略。
覆盖安装首次启动可靠性：profile 依赖保持优先，并在 Setup Finish 遇到 junction 替换窗口时回退到已安装 runtime。
透明插件安装：Marketplace 在确认前展示来源、运行环境、网络与图像外发、激活、降级、已知问题和验证信息。
rc.7 原生图片附件：支持图像的模型使用客户端持久化附件；纯文本模型保留显式外部 view_image 路径。
Linux x64 桌面分发：Electron 外壳现在可以打包原生 AppImage 与 deb，并按目标平台暂存 node-pty、sharp、koffi 和 Landlock launcher。
macOS Apple Silicon 桌面分发：Electron 外壳可以打包原生 darwin-arm64 应用和 DMG，并按目标平台暂存 node-pty、sharp 与 koffi 原生模块。
Linux 原生极简模式：官方预设通过 POSIX PTY 和 /bin/bash 运行；支持沙箱的模式使用 bwrap，或在回退到 Landlock 时失败关闭。
macOS 原生极简模式：官方预设通过 POSIX PTY 和 /bin/bash 运行，不使用 WSL 或容器兼容层。
平台感知发布流程：Windows 保留应用内便携更新，Linux/macOS 则打开发布页手动下载 AppImage/deb 或 DMG。
内置插件市场：每个 Web profile 首次使用时预装固定版本的 dsh-plugin-marketplace；用户可以关闭或卸载它，选择会在重启和升级后保持。
市场工具自包含：便携版通过 Electron 内置 Node.js 运行时提供 DSH 插件 CLI 和 pnpm，市场操作无需系统 Node.js 环境。
已验证更新恢复：启动器和更新器可从已验证的暂存目录修复发行版自有文件，同时保留事务与回滚安全性。
跨盘符 Setup 安装：安装器将 staging 保持在用户选择的应用目录下，即使安装到 D: 或 E:，runtime 激活也始终使用同卷重命名。
运行时占用恢复：覆盖安装会可靠结束桌面进程树，并重试释放 Electron/Node 文件句柄，避免运行中的旧版本阻断 runtime 切换。
启动脚本兼容性：统一 Windows CMD 脚本的 CRLF 行尾并避免非 ASCII 控制台命令，修复 Finish 后启动时出现 errorlevel 或乱码命令错误。
启动器事务检测：启动脚本兼容 PowerShell 5.1 JSON 的空格格式，正确识别 committed/rolled-back 状态，避免每次启动不必要的恢复延迟。
内容寻址打包缓存：对构建、暂存和 Electron 产物层生成指纹并安全复用，支持显式 --no-cache，并校验发布归档布局。

## New Features & Improvements

- **Linux x64 desktop distribution**: the Electron shell now packages native AppImage and deb artifacts with target-specific node-pty, sharp, koffi, and Landlock launcher components.
- **macOS Apple Silicon desktop distribution**: the Electron shell packages a native darwin-arm64 app and DMG with target-specific node-pty, sharp, and koffi addons.
- **Native Linux Minimal mode**: the official preset runs through the POSIX PTY and /bin/bash, while sandbox-capable modes use bwrap or fail-closed Landlock.

- **Platform-aware release flow**: Windows keeps in-app portable updates, while Linux/macOS open the release page for manual AppImage/deb or DMG downloads.
- **Bundled plugin marketplace**: each Web profile receives the pinned dsh-plugin-marketplace package once; users can disable or remove it and the choice persists across restarts and upgrades.
- **Self-contained marketplace tooling**: the portable release includes the DSH plugin CLI and pnpm behind the embedded Electron Node.js runtime, without requiring a system Node.js installation.
- **Verified update recovery**: startup and updater flows can repair release-owned payload files from verified staging while preserving transaction and rollback safety.
- **Cross-volume Setup installs**: installer staging now stays under the selected application directory, so runtime activation remains a same-volume rename even when installing to D: or E:.
- **Runtime lock recovery**: in-place Setup upgrades reliably terminate the desktop process tree and retry Electron/Node handle release, so a running old version no longer blocks the runtime switch.
- **Startup script compatibility**: Windows CMD scripts now use CRLF line endings and ASCII control messages, preventing errorlevel or garbled-command failures when Setup launches the app from Finish.
- **Launcher transaction detection**: startup wrappers tolerate PowerShell 5.1 JSON whitespace when checking committed or rolled-back transactions, avoiding unnecessary recovery delays.
- **Content-addressed packaging cache**: successful build, staging, and Electron layers are fingerprinted and safely reused, with explicit --no-cache support and release archive layout checks.

sections.titleZh: 问题修复与安装更新加固
itemsEn: Updater & installer hardening: resolved directory replacement edge-cases to prevent nested runtime directories, eliminated PowerShell output pipeline leaks, and added transaction journal state validation.
Setup installer resilience: enhanced pre-extraction cleanup and child process termination in Inno Setup to eliminate archive extraction permission errors.
WSL terminal subprocess cleanup: tightened terminal inspection and process tree lifecycle across Windows desktop sessions.
itemsZh: 更新与安装事务加固：重构目录原子替换逻辑，杜绝 Windows NTFS 句柄未释放时导致的 runtime 目录嵌套，清理 PowerShell 输出流泄露，并引入更新事务日志状态校验守护。
Setup 安装包稳健性优化：增强解压前的残留子进程终止与旧目录清理机制，杜绝安装时出现 tar 解压权限冲突问题。
WSL 终端子进程退出清理：进一步强化终端检查与进程树生命周期联动，确保会话退出时彻底清理资源。

itemsEn: Updater detection & asset fallback: fixed issue where new releases fetched via raw notes or history without explicit assetName caused the update modal to display false 'up to date' status, and automatically derive standard package names for valid SemVer releases.
itemsZh: 修复更新检测误报与资产包回退推导：修复当通过 Mirror/Raw 渠道拉取更新日志或历史记录中未显式指定 assetName 时导致模态框误判为“当前已是最新版本”的问题，并为所有合法 SemVer 版本自动推导标准便携分发包文件名。

itemsEn: WSL terminal environment sharing via WSLENV: seamlessly propagates Windows host terminal environment variables (PAGER, GIT_PAGER, TERM, DSH_*, etc.) into Linux sessions, eliminating pager hangs and unblocking readiness protocols.

Interactive SIGINT delivery for WSL: intercepts terminal interrupt requests and delivers the standard Ctrl+C byte into the PTY stream, allowing foreground tasks to abort immediately without waiting for timeouts.
Deterministic WSL process cleanup: binds host shutdown directly to PTY SIGKILL signals, ensuring background wsl.exe instances and terminal subprocesses are cleanly destroyed on exit.
Robust WSL diagnostic & cross-encoding detection: auto-adapts to UTF-16LE / UTF-8 outputs during environment probing, and provides actionable bilingual guidance when distributions are missing.
Vision Bridge design token alignment: harmonized CSS variables and card styles in @dsh-portable/vision-bridge with official microkernel design tokens across dark and light themes.
itemsZh: 通过 WSLENV 共享 WSL 终端环境变量：将 Windows 宿主环境中的终端与运行时变量（PAGER、GIT_PAGER、TERM、DSH_* 等）自动注入 Linux 会话，彻底消除 git/man 等命令因分页器阻塞的问题，确保就绪探测畅通无阻。
WSL 终端精确 SIGINT 中断响应：封装底层终端句柄，将前端发起的 SIGINT 信号转化为标准 Ctrl+C 字节流直接写入 PTY，使得前台正在执行的任务能够即时响应中断与停止，无需等待 300s 超时强制重置。
完善 WSL 终端进程生命周期与退出联动：修复进程树根节点逻辑，在宿主应用退出时联动调用 PTY SIGKILL 彻底销毁 wsl.exe 与后台终端资源，杜绝孤儿进程残留。
WSL 状态智能探测与跨编码自适应解码：自动识别并兼容 UTF-16LE / UTF-8 编码混杂的 wsl -l -q 输出，杜绝误判；针对未安装 Linux 发行版等异常场景提供中英文双语友好排错指引与一键修复建议。
视觉外挂（Vision Bridge）UI 规范与官方 Design Tokens 对齐：深度优化 @dsh-portable/vision-bridge 前端配置组件在浅色与深色主题下的视觉变量与卡片间距，界面表现更精致协调。

itemsEn: Native WSL environment bridge & RL Chain-of-Thought reproduction: seamlessly reproduces DeepSeek's native 'We need / Let's' step-by-step reasoning CoT on Windows by executing the official Minimal Preset in genuine Linux Bash.
Vision Bridge API proxy integration: dynamically exposes the vision configuration schema to the Host Web UI apiProxy, enabling seamless provider management and inspection directly in Settings.
Desktop UI interaction optimization: refined menu accordion expand animations, enhanced intuitive wording, polished SVG icons, and verified monolingual in-app release notes viewer.
Documentation & 'Why Us' value proposition: added comprehensive comparisons detailing how the Windows distribution overcomes PowerShell token divergence and terminal friction.
itemsZh: 强化 WSL 原生环境桥接与强化学习思维链复现：在 Windows 平台通过 WSL 原生 Linux Bash 完整承载官方极简模式（Minimal Preset），完美复现 DeepSeek 标志性的“We need / Let's”链式规划与分步推理思维链（CoT）。
视觉辅助外挂 API 代理层融合：动态将 vision 配置注入 Host Web UI apiProxy，实现【设置 → 插件】中视觉服务商的即时管理、参数校验与无缝调用。
桌面端交互细节与动效优化：深度优化菜单手风琴折叠展开动画、精简文案表述、升级矢量图标，并严格确保应用内更新日志单语言纯净渲染。
完善项目文档与 Why Us 核心差异说明：全面阐述 Windows 便携版本相较于官方版本在 Token 分布对齐、环境免配置与多模态扩展等方面的独特优势。

itemsEn: Added Vision Bridge plugin (@dsh-portable/vision-bridge): equips text-only models with multimodal visual inspection capabilities via OpenAI-compatible endpoints with modern cost-performance vision models (Gemini 3.7 Flash, Mimo V2.5, etc.).

Introduced the global 'view_image' tool: automatically inspects PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF images, resolves workspace paths against session cwd, enforces file bounds, and securely streams base64 Data URLs.
Seamless Settings integration: mounts a dedicated Vision card into the official Settings → Plugins tab with live provider presets, configuration validation, and write-only API key protection.
Zero-modification vendor isolation: cleanly wired through Cordis microkernel plugin slots and profile overlays without altering any upstream vendor/ code.
itemsZh: 新增视觉辅助外挂插件（@dsh-portable/vision-bridge）：为文本模型接入外部 OpenAI 兼容端点与高性价比多模态模型（如 Gemini 3.7 Flash、Mimo V2.5 等），赋予模型看图与识图能力。
引入全局 view_image 工具：支持 PNG、JPEG、WebP 与 GIF 图片文件，根据当前会话 cwd 智能解析相对路径，自动进行大小校验与 Base64 编码，并严格遵循防凭证重定向外泄的安全规范。
无缝融入官方设置中心：在【设置 → 插件】页面官方槽位注册专属配置卡片，支持服务商预设一键切换、即时配置验证与持久化保存，API Key 采用纯写模式与 Secret 级别安全脱敏保护。
零侵入架构设计：全部通过 Cordis 微内核插件机制与运行时 Overlay 动态装配，保持 upstream vendor/deepseek-harness 100% 原生纯净。

itemsEn: Implemented in-app pre-extraction staging for portable updates: downloading, SHA-256 integrity verification, and decompression now run transparently in the background while the application stays fully usable.
Reduced post-exit restart replacement downtime from 30+ seconds to 1–2 seconds via instant atomic directory swapping.
Provided transparent update status and user control with explicit 'Restart and Update Now' and 'Later' options.
Added update transaction mutex protection in startup scripts (启动桌面版.bat, start-desktop.cmd) to eliminate file lock collisions.
itemsZh: 重构便携版更新生命周期：引入运行时后台预解压（Staging）机制，下载、SHA-256 完整性校验与解压布局检查在软件运行期间透明完成。
退出后的重启替换耗时从 30+ 秒缩短至 1~2 秒，消除更新过程等待焦虑。
更新控制权全面透明化，界面明确提供【立即重启更新】与【稍后】选项，支持在方便时自主重启。
在启动脚本（启动桌面版.bat、start-desktop.cmd）中增加互斥保护与友好提示，杜绝用户在替换瞬间双击启动导致的文件占用冲突。

itemsEn: Supported the Minimal Agent Preset on Windows through native WSL Linux Bash aligned with official DeepSeek RL training distribution.
Injected a dedicated Win32 ProcessInspector stub and isolated danger-full-access sandbox policy for WSL persistent shell sessions.
Added WSL environment diagnostic and guidance dialog in the desktop menu with one-click 'wsl --install' command copy.
Implemented runtime launch error interception and actionable bilingual troubleshooting guidance for missing WSL environments.
itemsZh: 在 Windows 平台通过 WSL Linux 原生 Bash 正式支持极简模式（Minimal Preset），完美对齐 DeepSeek 官方 RL 训练环境。
引入 Win32 终端进程检查器桩，并在极简预设中启用 danger-full-access 隔离沙箱策略，彻底解决持久终端会话与 Hyper-V 权限问题。
在桌面菜单中新增 WSL 运行环境状态显示与自检入口，支持一键复制 'wsl --install' 安装命令。
实现运行时启动错误拦截与中英文双语友好排错指引，清晰提示标准模式（PowerShell）与极简模式差异。

itemsEn: Hardened WSL availability probe by stripping UTF-16 BOM and validating installed Linux distributions.
Added automatic background re-probing when opening desktop menus for real-time environment refresh.
itemsZh: 强化 WSL 可用性探测逻辑，自动剥离 UTF-16 BOM 并校验有效发行版列表，杜绝误判。
在展开桌面菜单时引入毫秒级动态重探测机制，用户安装 WSL 后免重启即刻刷新状态。

itemsEn: Added in-app update checker and one-click update downloader in the desktop menu.
